candidate.definition_en: To stop being angry with someone for something they have done.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تسامح حد وتنسى الغلط اللي عمله في حقك.

senses.definition_en: To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake.
senses.definition_ar: أن تسامح شخصًا وتعفو عنه وتتوقف عن الغضب منه بسبب خطأ ارتكبه.
examples: Please forgive me for not letting you know sooner.
It is hard to forgive someone who lied to you.
I can forgive the accident, but not the carelessness.
Please forgive me for not letting you know sooner.
It is hard to forgive someone who lied to you.
I can forgive the accident, but not the carelessness.
candidate.mnemonic: مكونة من 'For' و 'Give'.. كأنك بتعطي 'Give' السماح والعفو.
